book.name: Yohane
book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Yesu kanguaghulula maghulu ahundwa bhake

Likibhegha linjubha limu kali na kikubhukubhu kya Pasaka, Yesu kakimanya kukita lisaa lyake lya kubhuka pannima na kughenda kwa Tate likihika. Yesu kakiapala muno ahundwa bhake na kulyaghila kakiapala muno kyanga uhiko.
Hino, Yesu na ahundwa bhake bhakitama kulyegha mulyo ghwa makimuhi. Naywo Nchipila kakinnyingila kala Yuda, mwana ywa Simoni Isikaliote mwoyo ghwa kunkiluka Yesu.
Peni Yesu kakimanya kukita Tate kakimpegha makakala ghoha, na kakimanya kukita kakihuma kwa Chapanga na kangubhuya kwa Chapanga.
Habhu kakibhuka mu mulyo, kakihula lipinda lyake lya panji lya lihengo, na kakilikunga kitambala mukibhuno.
Mbole kakipopoha machi mu nkambo na kuyanda kuaghulula maghulu ahundwa bhake na kuapukuta kwa lila kitambala kyakalikungite handa nkungi.
Pakanhikilite Simoni Petili, Petili kakinng'ombela Yesu, “Bambo, bhuli, ghwenga ghwang'ulula maghulu ghangu?”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ghungumanya ng'obhe kinukitenda hinu, peni mbole ghwakimanya.”
Petili kakinng'ombela Yesu, “Akakaa, ghwenga ghwang'ulula ng'obhe nenga maghulu!” Yesu kakinnyanga, “Handa panughughulula ng'obhe, ghwenga ghwabhegha ng'obhe papamu na nenga kangi.”
Simoni Petili kakinnyanga, “Bambo, ghung'ulule kangi chepa maghulu ghweka, ngati papamu na mabhoko ghangu na mutwe bhubho!”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Mundu ywakayoghite kala kangunoghwa kukuha maghulu ghweka, kiyaha mmili ghwake ghoha ghubhegha nyanyi, peni ndo mabhoha ng'obhe.”
Yesu kakimmanya yula ywakapala kunkiluka, ndo mana kakilongela, “Mwenga nng'ululika, peni mabhoha ng'obhe.”
Yesu pakayomolite kuaghulula maghulu ghabhe, kakihwala kangi lipinda lyake, kakibhuya kutama pakulyegheha na kakiakonya. “Mungumanya agha ghanuatendelite?
Mwenga mungungema nenga Nhunda na Bambo, ayi tela, kiyaha ndo numeghite.
Hino, handa nenga Bambo na Nhunda ghwenu nubhaghulula maghulu, na mwenga bhubho mungunoghwa kulighulula maghulu mabhene kwa mabhene.
Nubhapegha nhwano aghu, ngati na mwenga bhubho ntende handa munuatendela.
Kulyaghia nunguaghombela, nndumindumi chepa nkulu kupitingana kwa bambo ghwake, hangi yunakulaghilwa nkulu ng'obhe kupitingana kwa ywakannaghilite.
Hino, handa mungughamanya agha, maanonelwa!”

“Nungulongela ng'obhe kwa mabhoha, kiyaha nenga nunguamanya bhanibhahaghulite. Peni mbaka ghatwihilike Malembo gha Chapanga ghaalongela, ‘Yula ywakalyeghite mulyo papamu na nenga, kabhegha mmyanja ywangu.’
Nenga ningubhaghombela mihalo ayi hinu yikali na kubwitukila, ngati paghabwituka mmokole kuhyubhalila kukita ‘Nenga mwene.’
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, ywohele ywakankingama yula yununnaghilite kangungingama nenga, na ywakangingama nenga kangunkingama yula ywakanaghilite.”
Yesu kangulongela kukita katakilukwa
Pakayomolite kulongela agha, Yesu kakibhaghaya muno mumwoyo ghwake, na kakilongela pekupeku, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, yumu ywenu katangiluka.”
Ahundwa bhake bhakilolekehana kyangamanya kukita kangunninga ghani.
Nhundwa yumu, ywene Yesu kakibhegha kangunpala muno, kakibhegha kangutama ugheghela na Yesu.
Hino, Simaoni Petili kakinnahila kibhoko na kakinng'ombela, “Ghunkonye kangunninga ghani?”
Habhu nhundwa aywo kakiheghelela ugheghela na Yesu na Kakinkonya, “Bambo, ndo ghani aywo?”

Yesu kakinnyanga, “Yula yumbala kunpegha kipalamande kya lingate mbole ya kukichwika mu bakuli, ndo yuywayu.” Habhu kakikitola kipalamande kya lingate, kakikichwika mukiluki na kakinpegha Yuda, mwana ghwa Isikaliote.
Yuda pakakingamite kila kipalamande kya lingate, Nchipia kakinnyingila. Hino, Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Kighukipala kukitenda ghukitende kanongola!”
Peni kahone hata yumu ywa bhala bhaatamite mu mulyo ywakamanyite kiyaha niki Yesu kakinng'ombela habhu.
Kiyaha Yuda kakibhegha mmika ngalabha, amoo bha ahundwa bhakihwacha kukita Yesu kakinng'ombela kakahemela hilibhi hya kikubhukubhu, ebu kakinng'ombela kakaapeghe makapukwa hilibhi hyohele.
Hino, Yuda pakakikingamite kala kila kipalamande kya lingate, kakibhuka unyumba kanongola. Nayo yikibhegha lubhindo.
Ngwiliho ya hyono
Mbole ya Yuda kubhuka unyumba, Yesu kakilongela, “Lisaa lihika kwa ukulu ghwa Mwana ywa Mundu ghwabhonekana pakindandabhanji, naywo Chapanga katakwehwa kwa ywombe.
Mwana katabhoneha bhula Chapanga paghubheghite nkulu. Mbole Chapanga katantola Mwana na kubhabhoneha bhandu bhula pakabheghite nkulu, katatenda habhu kwa kulopokela.

Bhana bhangu, megha papamu na mwenga kwa nndaluko ghwa mandina hela. Maambalaha, peni hinu nungaaghombela ghala ghanibhaghombilite hilongohi bha Akaayahudi, ‘Kung'enda nenga, mwenga mahotola ng'obhe kughenda.’
Nungubhapegha ngwiliho ya hyona, nlipale. Mulipale handa nenga panubhapalite.
Panpalana, bhandu bhoha bhaamanya kukita mwenga ndo ahundwa bha nenga.”
Yesu kangulongela kukita Petili katankana
Simoni Petili kakinkonya Yesu, “Bambo ghungughenda kwoki?” Yesu kakinnyanga Petili, “Kung'enda nenga ghwahotola ng'obhe kundughila hinu, peni ghwandughila mbole yake.”
Petili kakinkonya kangi Yesu, “Bambo kya bhuli nenga ndahotola ng'obhe kughutughila hinu? Nenga Megha kala mbaka kuhwegha kwakya ghwenga!”
Yesu kakinnyanga Petili, “Bhuli, ghwenga ghwaghubhuha ubhumi ghwako kwakya nenga? Kulyaghila nungughughombela, yikali na mbichi kubhika, ghwangana pandatu kukita ghungumanya ng'obhe.”
